# Sweet Confections by Kelsey

> Licensed and insured home bakery in Pittsfield, Massachusetts (Berkshire County), run by baker Kelsey Hecht. Everything is baked from scratch — custom celebration cakes, wedding cakes, cupcakes, cookies, brownies, cinnamon buns, chocolate-dipped strawberries, brunch boxes, and scratch-made frozen custard. Pickup in Pittsfield, MA, with delivery across the Berkshires, Western Massachusetts, Eastern New York, Southern Vermont, and Northwest Connecticut (roughly a 1–2 hour radius). 5.0-star rated by customers on Google and Facebook.

Key facts:

- Business: Sweet Confections by Kelsey, a licensed & insured home bakery (fully custom, made-to-order — no storefront)
- Location: Pittsfield, MA 01201, in the Berkshires
- Service area: Berkshire County MA (Pittsfield, Lenox, Stockbridge, Lee, Great Barrington, Williamstown, North Adams and surrounding towns), Western MA (Northampton, Springfield), Eastern NY (Albany, Troy, Hudson), Southern VT (Bennington, Manchester), Northwest CT (Salisbury, Litchfield)
- Contact: sctreatsshop@gmail.com · (413) 358-8556 · https://sctreatsbakery.com
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/SweetConfectionsShop/ · https://www.instagram.com/sctreatsbakery/
- Ordering: request-based — customers submit an order request online and Kelsey confirms availability, final pricing, and pickup/delivery within 24 hours. Orders can be placed from anywhere (out-of-state gift orders for local recipients are common).
- Lead times: cookies, brownies, cupcakes, and most treats 24–48 hours; custom cakes about 1 week; wedding/event packages and cake bars 2–4 weeks
- Prices: custom celebration cakes from $70, themed character cakes from $75, wedding/event cakes from $120, smash cake + cupcake set from $55, cupcakes from $30/dozen, Build Your Own Brunch Box from $28, frozen custard $14/pint, Build-Your-Own Cake Bar event packages $150–$250, wedding cake bar packages $1,100–$1,950
- Frozen custard: scratch-made, $14 per pint, rotating flavors — Holy Crumbs (homemade vanilla custard with homemade chocolate chip cookie pieces, brownie pieces, vanilla crumble, and cookie butter), Blueberry Cobbler, Peach Cobbler, Apple Cobbler, Peanut Butter & Banana, Milk Chocolate — with new flavors announced on Facebook
- 14 scratch-made cake flavors and 14 frostings; gluten-free cake flavors available on request
- A dessert food truck is in the works, targeting a 2026 launch
